Without this label the predictability metric stops existing, and it is the only one that explains why a month with good throughput can still be unstable.

TIPS.<th>Committed</th>: Story points already in the sprint the day it started.
TIPS.<th>Added</th>: Story points pulled into the sprint after it had already started.
TIPS.<th>Completed</th>: Story points that reached a Done status before the sprint closed.
TIPS.<th>Left sprint</th>: Story points that did not finish inside the sprint: removed before it closed, or still open at close. Jira moves them out, which is why the burndown can reach zero.
TIPS.<th>vs commit</th>: Completed divided by the day-1 commitment. Above 100% means the sprint delivered more than it set out to.
TIPS.<th>Added: reactive</th>: Points added mid-sprint carrying a reactive marker: labeled Unplanned, or typed Urgent Task.
TIPS.<th>Added: plannable</th>: Points added mid-sprint with no reactive marker — work that could have been planned in from day 1.
TIPS.<th>% reactive</th>: Reactive points as a share of everything added after day 1.
TIPS.<td>Throughput (closed)</td>: Items that reached Closed during the month. Sub-tasks and epics excluded; discarded work is not counted.
TIPS.<td>Unplanned work</td>: Share of the month’s closed items labeled Unplanned. Target is 5% or below.
TIPS.<td>Cycle Time (median)</td>: Calendar days from the first entry into In Development until closure, median across the month.
TIPS.<td>Closed without entering development<: Items closed without ever recording a transition into In Development. They have no Cycle Time, so they sit outside that metric.
TIPS.<td>Discarded (Won't Do)</td>: Resolved as Won’t Do. Counted separately because discarded work is not delivered work.
TIPS.<div class=\"k\">Committed at start</div: Story points in the sprint on day 1, before anything was added.
TIPS.<div class=\"k\">Added during sprint</di: Story points pulled in after the sprint started. For a service team some of this is unavoidable.
TIPS.<div class=\"k\">Completed</div>: Story points closed inside the sprint window.
TIPS.<div class=\"k\">vs commitment</div>: Completed against the day-1 commitment, not against final scope.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Throughput</span>: Items closed per month. Measures delivery capacity, not effort or complexity.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Cycle Time</span>: How long an item takes from the moment work starts until it closes, in calendar days.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Planned vs Unplann: Share of delivered work that was reactive. Measures predictability, not productivity.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Work In Progress ·: Items sitting in In Development or Awaiting Review right now. Policy is 2 per developer, with review at half that.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Work In Progress</: Items in In Development or Awaiting Review. A point-in-time reading, not a monthly total.
TIPS.<span class=\"gname\">Delivered vs disca: Closed items against those resolved as Won’t Do in the same month.
